criteria.description: Workbook opens and contains Documents, Items, Categories, Exceptions, Provenance, and Reconciliation.
Each supplied receipt is represented once with the correct merchant, date, and source filename, independent of row order or candidate-assigned document ID.
Each receipt item is represented once with the correct source receipt, description, modifier, amount, and category.
Document and item IDs/linkage are non-empty, unique where required, and complete without duplicate source items.
Each document subtotal, tax, and total is formula-linked where applicable and evaluates to the receipt-grounded amount.
Both manifest-selected item changes, drawn from different receipts, update the affected document, category, and batch totals while preserving unrelated receipts.
Category-summary values are formula-linked and agree with the receipt-grounded category totals, independent of row order.
Each item links once to the correct receipt image with a candidate-readable locator; no private locator token is required.
Reconciliation document count, item count, and batch total are formula-linked and evaluate correctly.
Penalty for missing/duplicated source items, false receipt identity, wrong category, stale batch total, or false provenance.
